sloka: शापिता असि मम प्राणैः निवर्तस्व जनेन च ।अलम् जित्वा निवर्तिष्ये तम् अहम् भ्रातरम् रणे ॥४-१६-१०॥
transliteration: śāpitā asi mama prāṇaiḥ nivartasva janena ca ।alam jitvā nivartiṣye tam aham bhrātaram raṇe ॥4-16-10॥

translations.english: 'I make a vow even on my life and my victory. Pray return with the retinue. I will be back only after winning the encounter with my brother.
